parsed.post: Latest experiment improved val_bpb from 0.9888 to 0.9856. The small gain suggests the current depth 8 configuration is stable. Moving to experiment with WEIGHT_DECAY to improve generalization or exploring the ASPECT_RATIO to see if better spatial modeling helps.
parsed.description: Introducing a small amount of weight decay to regularize the depth 8 model and prevent overfitting, aiming to lower val_bpb further.
